runtime_boundary: exact NPC dialogue admission and completion ownership
behavior: talk resolves an existing alive NPC instance in the character's current canonical room
world runtime allocates a monotonic per-instance dialogue request generation
only one active dialogue request may own an NPC instance at a time
quest dialogue dispatch begins only after exact admission
completion must match the exact active request ID
matched, unmatched, and dispatch-exception outcomes are persisted compactly
safe_fallback: reject missing, dead, wrong-room, actorless, concurrent, or mismatched requests without executing or completing dialogue
character_save_impact: existing quest-dialogue state changes remain owned by the quest dialogue runtime
world_state_impact: dialogue ownership and audit metadata persist on the NPC runtime instance
